[EN] This Zik character has to still be on the island.

While you're looking for him, keep up the pretense of taking down monsters...the gods know we could use all the help we can get on that score.

If I get any reports of a man in black, I'll let you know as soon as possible. Meanwhile, if you learn anything else, report it to Leander. He'll be here in the Southern Camp, waiting for your report."I'm on it."
[ES] Este sujeto Zik aún debe estar en la isla.

Mientras lo buscas, mantén la farsa de acabar con monstruos... los dioses saben que nos vendría bien toda la ayuda posible en ese aspecto.

Si recibo algún informe sobre un hombre de negro, te avisaré lo antes posible. Mientras tanto, si te enteras de algo más, infórmalo a Leander. Estará aquí en el campamento del sur, esperando tu reporte."I'm on it."

[EN] So. You again. I was expecting...well, never mind all that. You're here now.

Are you here to do business?"I'm here to...to finalize the price."
[ES] Vaya. Tú otra vez. Esperaba... bueno, olvídate de todo eso. Ya estás aquí.

¿Vienes a hacer negocios?"I'm here to...to finalize the price."

[EN] You're joking.

I think I'm done dealing with you. You are clearly stalling me, which means you don't have the merchandise...and since I have heard from the treasure hunter, I'm guessing that means he's the one who has it—not you.

That means I have no reason to waste any more time with you. Don't bother me again."I'm sure we'll meet again."
[ES] Estás bromeando.

Creo que he terminado de hacer tratos contigo. Claramente me estás dando largas, lo que significa que no tienes la mercancía... y como he tenido noticias del cazador de tesoros, supongo que él es quien la tiene, no tú.

Eso significa que no tengo razón para perder más tiempo contigo. No me molestes otra vez."I'm sure we'll meet again."

[EN] The magister of the Free Traders Collective is involved with this? And she's after some kind of "sap?"

That can only mean sap from the World Tree...which means the treasure hunter probably destroyed the tree trying to harvest its sap.

That's a crime against the federation...not to mention the gods themselves!
"What's our next move?"
[ES] ¿El magister del Colectivo de Libres Mercaderes está involucrado en esto? ¿Y busca algún tipo de "savia"?

Eso solo puede significar savia del Árbol del Mundo... lo que significa que el cazador de tesoros probablemente destruyó el árbol intentando extraer su savia.

¡Eso es un crimen contra la federación... por no hablar de los dioses mismos!
"What's our next move?"

[EN] We need to capture that treasure hunter, preferably while he's making the trade with Molva.

I'll send word of our plan to Adria, and she can be our backup.
Go on ahead,. I'll follow as soon as I'm sure Adria has received the message."Don't be late."
[ES] Necesitamos capturar a ese cazador de tesoros, preferiblemente mientras hace el trato con Molva.

Le avisaré de nuestro plan a Adria para que nos sirva de respaldo.
Adelántate, yo te seguiré en cuanto esté seguro de que Adria ha recibido el mensaje."Don't be late."

[EN] You had better have a very good reason for this..."You conspired to destroy the World Tree and profit from it."
[ES] Más te vale tener una muy buena razón para esto..."You conspired to destroy the World Tree and profit from it."

[EN] Thanks for your help, . We'll take it from here.End Conversation.
[ES] Gracias por tu ayuda, . Nosotros nos encargamos desde aquí.End Conversation.
